title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry — Rewards on Large and Small Guest Gifts
content:
On the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, the gift size decides how the gift's rewards percent is taken on a guest gift entry:

- a gift entry of at least the taper threshold of **USD 500.00** earns the full percent on USD 500.00 and half the percent on the part above it;
- a gift entry below the small-gift floor of **USD 25.00** earns no rewards;
- any other gift entry earns the percent on its whole amount.

The rounding to the cent is made once, half up, on the final amount.

## Worked gifts (hypothetical rewards percent of 7)

| Gift entry amount | How the percent is taken | Unrounded | Rewards |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 24.99 | below the floor | — | nothing |
| USD 25.00 | 7 percent of USD 25.00 | USD 1.75 | USD 1.75 |
| USD 499.99 | 7 percent of USD 499.99 | USD 34.9993 | USD 35.00 |
| USD 500.00 | 7 percent of USD 500.00, nothing above | USD 35.00 | USD 35.00 |
| USD 800.00 | 7 percent of USD 500.00 plus 3.5 percent of USD 300.00 | USD 45.50 | USD 45.50 |

## Points of judgement

- Exactly USD 500.00 already falls in the large-gift band; exactly USD 25.00 is no longer below the floor.
- Only the part above USD 500.00 earns at half the percent; the first USD 500.00 always earns the full percent.
